property_summary: For any caller and any log address, after SetLogFile(logAddr) every subsequent Deposit must be recorded by the contract at logAddr; the mutant sets Log to msg.sender instead, so with a caller different from logAddr the deposit is never recorded.
change_summary: Replace 'Log = LogFile(_log);' with 'Log = LogFile(msg.sender);' so Log is set to the caller's address instead of the argument.
